description: Recommended, optional one-time upgrade of a verified sending domain to the current per-domain CNAME DNS records, for better deliverability and security, without removing it; it keeps sending on current records and sending is normally not interrupted at the switch. Once started it runs to the switch. Needs website.dnsUpgrade.status available; an older SES-only domain also needs a DMARC record (400 otherwise). Publish the returned dnsUpgrade.records CNAMEs next to the current records, removing nothing; the domain switches by itself about an hour after the required ones are public (verify_sending_domain checks now, no skip). Removing dnsUpgrade.oldRecords (listed beforehand as replacedRecords) after deleteOldRecordsAfter (8 days) is optional; each is marked removed once gone from public DNS.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

mailFromPrefix.description: Optional return-path label, default rp (then rp1, sqrp); SES one is <label>2. Not a label with DNS records.

name: upgrade_sending_domain_dns

website.description: The Sending domain; dnsUpgrade.records lists the CNAMEs to publish, each {purpose, type, name, value, required, status, diagnostic?}; dnsUpgrade.replacedRecords lists the current records to remove after the switch, each {type, name, removed} record returned by Sequenzy.
